title: Anwalk
wikitext:
{{Infobox map |name=Walk in the Park |year=Feb 2020 |image=Anwalk.jpg |creator={{player|anni|flag=de}} |gametype=4on4 FFA |size=Large |download=https://maps.quakeworld.nu/core/anwalk.bsp |loc=https://maps.quakeworld.nu/locs/anwalk.loc }} During the New Year's turn 2020/2021, '''Anwalk''' was created in one week. After another week of testing, the last adjustments were made and the map was published. It is {{player|Anni|flag=de}}'s second serious attempt to bring a [[4on4]] map into the Quakeworld scene. Although the map is relatively large, every place can be reached quickly using teleporters and bunny hopping. Outside open places invites for shaft fights, whereas inside the buildings the [[RL]] becomes more dominant. The map is designed in such a way that ''camping is extremely hard'' because all resources are located outside the key locations, which makes the map very dynamic.
